Word counter

Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type.

Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Paste your draft to get a live word count. Hyphenated words count as one word when there are no surrounding spaces. Reading time uses 200 words per minute, a planning estimate rather than a measured reading speed.

Try this example

A 1,000-word article takes about 5 minutes to read at 200 words per minute.

How your data is handled ↗

Good to know

Does it save my writing?

No. Text stays in this page’s memory and is cleared when you reload.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
